teaser: Peter's last written words were an instruction that never expires.

title: Faithful to Forgive
verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
meaning: John promises that if we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and cleanse us from all wrongdoing. Forgiveness does not depend on feelings. It depends on God's faithfulness.
heart: Some men confess the same sin again and again, never believing they are forgiven. If you have confessed, you are forgiven and cleansed. Thank God for it today, and walk in that freedom.
holdOn: When I confess, God is faithful to forgive and cleanse me.
prayer: God, I confess my sins to you. Thank you that you are faithful and just to forgive me and make me clean. Help me believe it and walk in freedom today. Amen.
teaser: John made a promise about confession that depends on God, not on how you feel.

title: Someone Speaks for You
verse: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
meaning: John writes so that believers will not sin. But if they do, they have an advocate with the Father: Jesus Christ, the righteous one. Jesus stands up for us before God, like a defense lawyer.
heart: When you fail, it can feel like you are on trial alone. You are not. Jesus speaks for you. Do not hide from God after a failure. Go to him, knowing Jesus is already on your side.
holdOn: When I fail, Jesus stands up for me before the Father.
prayer: Jesus, thank you for being my advocate with the Father. When I fail, I will not hide. Help me run to God, trusting that you speak for me. Help me not to sin today. Amen.
teaser: John said that when you fail, you are not standing alone. Someone speaks for you.

title: Called Children of God
verse: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
meaning: John says to look at how great a love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are. It is not just a title. It is our real identity.
heart: Many men grow up without hearing a father say: you are my son. God says it to you. Let that sink in today. Before you do anything else, say: I am a child of God, and he loves me.
holdOn: The Father calls me his child, and that is who I really am.
prayer: Father, thank you for the great love you have given me. I am your child. Heal the places where I felt fatherless, and help me live today as your loved son. Amen.
teaser: John wanted you to look at something. It is about what God calls you.

title: Love in Action
verse: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
meaning: John tells believers not to love only with words or talk, but with actions and in truth. Love that never moves is not really love at all. Real love gets up and does something.
heart: It is easy to say I love you, or I am praying for you. Back it up today. Do one loving action for someone you care about: show up, help, give, fix or listen.
holdOn: I love with actions and truth, not just with words.
prayer: God, I do not want my love to be only words. Help me love in action and truth. Show me one person who needs to see my love today, not just hear about it. Amen.
teaser: John said real love has a test. Words alone do not pass it.

title: He Loved Us First
verse: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
meaning: John defines love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to pay for our sins. Love starts with God. Our love is only ever a response to his.
heart: You do not have to earn God's love by loving him well first. He loved you first, even at your worst. Let that free you from performing for him today, and love him back gladly.
holdOn: God loved me first. My love is a response to his.
prayer: God, thank you that you loved me first, before I ever loved you. Thank you for sending Jesus to pay for my sins. Free me from performing, and let me love you back. Amen.
teaser: John gave the Bible's clearest definition of love. It does not start with you.

title: He Hears Us
verse: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
meaning: John says believers can have confidence before God. If we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. Prayer is not shouting into the void. God listens to his children.
heart: Pray with confidence today. Ask for things you know God wants: wisdom, courage, a clean heart, love for others. He hears those prayers. Ask for one of them specifically and expect his help.
holdOn: When I pray according to God's will, he hears me.
prayer: God, thank you that you hear me when I pray. Give me confidence to ask for what you want: wisdom, courage, purity and love. I ask for these today. Amen.
teaser: John said some prayers are always heard. Here is what they have in common.

title: Love Means Walking
verse: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
meaning: John says that love means walking in obedience to God's commands. And his command is to walk in love. Love and obedience are not opposites. They are two sides of the same walk.
heart: Some think obedience is cold and love is warm. John ties them together. Loving God looks like doing what he says, and what he says is love people. Walk in one act of love today.
holdOn: Loving God means walking in his ways, and his way is love.
prayer: God, help me see that obeying you and loving you go together. Help me walk in your commands today, and let my walk be full of love for you and for others. Amen.
teaser: John connected two things people often think are opposites: love and obedience.

title: No Greater Joy
verse: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
meaning: John, now an old man, wrote to a friend he had mentored. He said he had no greater joy than hearing that his spiritual children were walking in the truth. Faithful lives were his reward.
heart: Someday you may mentor younger men. Your greatest joy will be seeing them walk in truth. Start now: invest in a younger guy, and walk in truth yourself so he has something to follow.
holdOn: I want to walk in truth, and help younger men walk in it too.
prayer: God, help me walk in truth every day. Give me a younger man to invest in, and let my life be worth following. Let me know the same joy John knew. Amen.
teaser: An old man named his greatest joy. It was not money, fame or comfort.

title: Stay in God's Love
verse: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
meaning: Jude warns about false teachers. Then he tells believers to keep themselves in God's love while they wait for the mercy of Jesus. God's love does not change, but we can drift from living in it.
heart: You do not earn God's love, but you can wander from enjoying it. Stay close: pray, read, worship and stay with your brothers. Do one thing today to keep yourself where his love is.
holdOn: I keep myself in God's love and wait for his mercy.
prayer: God, keep me in your love. When I drift toward lies and empty things, pull me back. Help me stay close to you while I wait for the mercy of Jesus. Amen.
teaser: Jude told believers to stay somewhere. It was not a place, but a love.

title: Kept From Falling
verse: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
meaning: Jude ends with praise to God, who is able to keep us from stumbling. He will present us faultless before his glory with great joy. Our future does not depend on our grip, but on his.
heart: Some days you feel like you are hanging on by a thread. Jude says God is able to keep you from falling. Lean on his strength today, and thank him for holding you.
holdOn: God is able to keep me from falling and present me with joy.
prayer: God, thank you that you are able to keep me from falling. When my grip is weak, hold me. Present me faultless before you with joy. To you be glory forever. Amen.
teaser: Jude ends his short letter with one of the most hopeful sentences in the Bible.

title: The Beginning and the End
verse: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
meaning: John saw a vision of the Lord God, who calls himself the Alpha and the Omega. Those are the first and last letters of the Greek alphabet. God is the beginning and end of everything. He was, is and is to come.
heart: Your story has a beginning and an end, and God is bigger than both. He holds your past and your future. If you feel anxious about what is ahead today, remember who holds the end.
holdOn: God is the beginning and the end, and he holds my story.
prayer: Lord God, you are the Alpha and the Omega. You hold my beginning and my end. When I worry about the future, remind me that you are already there. Amen.
teaser: God described himself using two letters. Together they say everything.

title: Jesus Knocks
verse: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
meaning: Jesus spoke to a church that had grown lukewarm and comfortable. He said he stands at the door and knocks. If anyone hears and opens, he will come in and eat with him, like a friend.
heart: Jesus does not kick down the door. He knocks. Maybe you have let your faith go lukewarm. He is still knocking. Open the door today with a simple, honest prayer, and invite him to the table.
holdOn: Jesus is knocking. I open the door and invite him in.
prayer: Jesus, I hear you knocking. I have been lukewarm and distracted for too long. I open the door. Come in, eat with me, and be close to me again, like a friend. Amen.
teaser: Jesus stood at the door of a lukewarm church. He did not kick it down.

title: Worthy Is the Lamb
verse: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
meaning: In John's vision, heaven sings a new song to Jesus, the Lamb. He is worthy because he was killed and with his blood bought people for God from every tribe, language, people and nation.
heart: God's family is bigger than your neighborhood, your country or your culture. Jesus bought people from every nation. Today, pray for believers in another part of the world, and thank Jesus for paying for you.
holdOn: Jesus is worthy, because he bought me and people from every nation.
prayer: Jesus, you are worthy. You gave your life to buy people from every nation, including me. Thank you. Help me love your whole family, not just the people who look like me. Amen.
teaser: Heaven sings a new song in Revelation. The lyrics include your story.

title: Springs of Living Water
verse: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
meaning: John saw a great crowd in heaven who had come through great suffering. The Lamb will be their shepherd and lead them to springs of living water. God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
heart: Some tears you carry may never fully dry in this life. But God promises to wipe every one away. Bring him your sorrow today, and let this promise give you strength to keep going.
holdOn: One day God will wipe away every tear from my eyes.
prayer: God, you know the tears I carry. Thank you for the promise that you will wipe them all away. Lead me to living water now, and give me strength until that day. Amen.
teaser: John saw a crowd that had come through great suffering. Here is what God did.

title: They Overcame
verse: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
meaning: John saw believers who overcame the accuser. They won by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. They loved God more than their own lives, even facing death.
heart: Your victory comes from what Jesus did and from telling what he has done for you. Your story is a weapon against the enemy's lies. Share your testimony with one person this month.
holdOn: I overcome by the blood of the Lamb and the word of my testimony.
prayer: Jesus, thank you that your blood has already won the victory. Give me courage to share what you have done for me. Help me love you more than my own comfort. Amen.
teaser: Revelation names two weapons that defeat the enemy. You have both.

title: No More Death
verse: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
meaning: John saw a new heaven and a new earth. God will live with his people. He will wipe away every tear. There will be no more death, mourning, crying or pain. The old order will be gone.
heart: This world's pain is not the end of the story. Everything broken will be made new. When you face loss or pain today, hold on to this future. It is not wishful thinking. It is God's promise.
holdOn: One day there will be no more death, crying or pain.
prayer: God, I long for the day when you make everything new. Until then, help me carry pain with hope. Thank you that death and tears will not have the final word. Amen.
teaser: John saw the end of the story. Four things will be gone forever.

title: No More Night
verse: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
meaning: In the final vision, John says there will be no night in God's city. No lamps or sun will be needed, because the Lord God himself will be their light. They will reign with him forever.
heart: Some nights feel long: grief, temptation, loneliness. A day is coming with no more night. Let that hope steady you through the darkest hour you face this week. Morning is coming for good.
holdOn: A day is coming with no more night, because God will be my light.
prayer: Lord God, thank you that a day is coming with no more night. Be my light now in the dark hours. Help me walk in hope until I see your face. Amen.
teaser: Revelation describes a city that never needs a lamp. Here is why.

title: Come
verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
meaning: The Bible ends with an invitation. The Spirit and the church say: come. Anyone who is thirsty may come and take the water of life freely. After everything, God's door is still open.
heart: You made it through a year in God's word. That is not the end. It is an invitation to keep coming. Whatever this year held, come again tomorrow. And invite one friend to come with you.
holdOn: The invitation still stands. I keep coming to God, and I bring others.
prayer: God, thank you for walking with me through this year in your word. I am still thirsty for you. I come again. Give me the water of life, and help me invite others to come. Amen.
teaser: The Bible's last invitation is one word long. It is still open to you.
